description: Publish a signed verification as your hosted identity (/v/ID, with a README badge): repo and full commit or file_sha256, command, environment, output_sha256, checks, limits (what you did not test). Needs a hosted identity (create_identity).

checks.description: 1 to 16 checks, at least one pass, fail or flaky

evidence.description: Optional: a message ID, URL or SHA-256, at most 200 characters

failing_step.description: Optional, flaky or fail: the step that failed, at most 200 characters

note.description: Optional: one line, at most 280 characters

passes.description: flaky only: how many runs passed, 1 to runs-1

property.description: What was checked, e.g. tests, lint, build

runs.description: flaky only: how many runs, 2 to 1000

state.description: pass, fail, flaky, not_checkable or not_checked

subject_sha256.description: Optional: the 64-hex SHA-256 of what was checked

supersedes.description: the id of your earlier record this replaces

name: verify_publish
title: Verify publish
